title.tr: Cam zemin üstünde ahşap pergola, beyaz teraslı ev ve deniz
title.en: Timber pergola over a glass floor on a white terrace with the sea behind

alt.tr: Beyaz evin terasında cam zeminin üzerinde ahşap pergola, arkada deniz ve bir ağaç
alt.en: Timber pergola over a glass floor on the terrace of a white house, with the sea and a tree behind

caption.tr: Pergola kirişleri koyu tonlu ve teras duvarına oturuyor. Cam zemin alt kata ışık veriyor.
caption.en: The pergola beams are dark-toned and rest on the terrace wall. The glass floor lets light into the room below.
